missions.title: Golden Parachute
missions.briefing: A protected corporate executive is moving through the district. Eliminate the executive; the security detail is optional.

missions.title: Chrome Breaker
missions.briefing: A heavily augmented cyberpsycho is attacking anyone who enters the area. Neutralize the target before the violence spreads.

missions.title: Quiet Acquisition
missions.briefing: Access a secured terminal inside a corporate building. The patrols detect exposed movement slowly; crouching and cover provide a quiet route.

missions.title: Sealed Manifest
missions.briefing: Carry the issued shipment to the marked district. Payment transfers only when every configured cargo item is still in your inventory.
